Answer faster, in your own voice — not a bot's.

We built ReplyDeck because small support teams get crushed by tools built for enterprises. If you're using Gmail, you're missing replies. If you're using Zendesk, you're overpaying and over-configuring.

ReplyDeck is a shared inbox that drafts replies in your team’s actual voice by learning from your past conversations. No training docs. No bot scripts. Just real replies, faster.

We’ve seen teams cut first-response time by 40% — and our largest customer handles 20,000 tickets/month on the standard plan.

Built for teams of 2–10. Five-minute setup. Flat $29/seat/month.
